name: project_create
title: Create project
description: Create a new project with the pecot-workflow fields, and the pecot-lane field and the Lanes view from lanes (to add the fields to an existing project, use project_init)

lanes.description: Values of the pecot-lane field: the areas of work, such as plugins, teams or services. GitHub shows them on the board, so use English names. Values already on the board are kept

number.description: Number of the created project (omitted when the response has none)

url.description: URL of the created project (omitted when the response has none)

fields.description: The fields of the created project, in the same rows as project_init (omitted when the command stopped before the fields)

change.description: create: the field was created; update: options were added to it; unchanged: nothing to do; skip: the field was not found, pecot-lane was not created because no lanes were given, or pecot-lane is not a single select field; rename: the old pecot-workflow-<suffix> field was renamed to pecot-status; delete: the field was deleted with confirm_delete

addedOptions.description: Names of the options added to the field (empty when none)

created.description: Whether the view was created; false when a view of that name already exists or it has to be created by hand

url.description: URL of the view (omitted when it has to be created by hand)

manual_steps.description: Steps to create the view on the board, when GitHub refused to create it (omitted otherwise)

view.description: The Lanes view, with pecot-status as the columns and pecot-lane as the groups (omitted when the board has no single select pecot-lane field)

detail.description: Full failure text: the error message and the guidance lines that follow it (failure only)

log.description: Raw output of a child process (failure only; omitted when not captured)

warnings.description: Warning messages; continuation lines of a message are indented by two spaces (omitted when there is none)
